git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller:refs/remotes/origin/mvp/environment-controller
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
header = Path("src/climate/Stage28dLampSafety.h").read_text()
impl = Path("src/climate/Stage28dLampSafety.cpp").read_text()
observer = Path("scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py").read_text()
assert "Safe = 0U" in header
assert "TimerOff," in header
assert "TemperatureUnavailable," in header
assert "OverTemperature," in header
assert "RecoveryHold," in header
assert "InvalidConfig," in header
assert "output.reason = output.schedule_requests_lamp_on ? LampSafetyReason::Safe" in impl
assert ": LampSafetyReason::TimerOff;" in impl
needle = "safety == 0\n                            and force == 0\n                            and reason == 0"
assert observer.count(needle) == 3, observer.count(needle)
print("STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_PRECHECK_PASS")
PY

set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py")
text = path.read_text()

constant_anchor = 'STAGE28D_OUTPUT_MARKER = "stage28d_output "\n'
constant_insert = (
    'STAGE28D_OUTPUT_MARKER = "stage28d_output "\n'
    'LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_SAFE = 0\n'
    'LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_TIMER_OFF = 1\n'
    'H_SAFETY_CLEAR_REASONS = frozenset(\n'
    '    (LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_SAFE, LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_TIMER_OFF)\n'
    ')\n'
)
assert constant_anchor in text
assert "H_SAFETY_CLEAR_REASONS" not in text
text = text.replace(constant_anchor, constant_insert, 1)

helper_anchor = (
    'def is_stage28d_output_line(line: str) -> bool:\n'
    '    # ESP-IDF serial logs prefix ESP_LOG output with timestamp/tag metadata.\n'
    '    # Accept both raw service-console-style payloads and prefixed log lines.\n'
    '    return STAGE28D_OUTPUT_MARKER in line\n\n\n'
)
helper_insert = helper_anchor + (
    'def is_h_safety_clear(safety_latched: int, force_fan: int, reason: int) -> bool:\n'
    '    # TimerOff is normal schedule state, not a thermal safety condition.\n'
    '    return (\n'
    '        safety_latched == 0\n'
    '        and force_fan == 0\n'
    '        and reason in H_SAFETY_CLEAR_REASONS\n'
    '    )\n\n\n'
)
assert helper_anchor in text
text = text.replace(helper_anchor, helper_insert, 1)

old = "safety == 0\n                            and force == 0\n                            and reason == 0"
count = text.count(old)
assert count == 3, count
text = text.replace(old, "is_h_safety_clear(safety, force, reason)")
path.write_text(text)

test_path = Path("tests/test_stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py")
assert not test_path.exists()
test_path.write_text(
    'from __future__ import annotations\n\n'
    'import importlib.util\n'
    'import sys\n'
    'import types\n'
    'from pathlib import Path\n\n\n'
    'SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts" / "stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py"\n\n\n'
    'def load_observer():\n'
    '    sys.modules.setdefault("serial", types.SimpleNamespace(Serial=object))\n'
    '    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent_test_module", SCRIPT)\n'
    '    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None\n'
    '    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n'
    '    sys.modules[spec.name] = module\n'
    '    spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n'
    '    return module\n\n\n'
    'def test_h_safety_clear_accepts_safe_and_timer_off() -> None:\n'
    '    observer = load_observer()\n'
    '    assert observer.is_h_safety_clear(0, 0, observer.LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_SAFE)\n'
    '    assert observer.is_h_safety_clear(0, 0, observer.LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_TIMER_OFF)\n\n\n'
    'def test_h_safety_clear_rejects_actual_safety_reasons_and_forcing() -> None:\n'
    '    observer = load_observer()\n'
    '    for reason in (2, 3, 4, 5):\n'
    '        assert not observer.is_h_safety_clear(0, 0, reason)\n'
    '    assert not observer.is_h_safety_clear(1, 0, observer.LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_SAFE)\n'
    '    assert not observer.is_h_safety_clear(0, 1, observer.LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_SAFE)\n'
)
print("STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_PATCHED")
PY
PYTHON=.venv/bin/python
if [ ! -x "$PYTHON" ]; then PYTHON=$(command -v python3); fi
"$PYTHON" -m py_compile scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py tests/test_stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py
"$PYTHON" -m pytest -q tests/test_stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py
"$PYTHON" scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py --help >/dev/null
echo STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_FOCUSED_PASS

set -euo pipefail
PYTHON=.venv/bin/python
if [ ! -x "$PYTHON" ]; then PYTHON=$(command -v python3); fi
if [ -f /tmp/stage28e_h_v7_corrected_parser_v1.log ]; then
  "$PYTHON" - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path

script = Path("scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent_replay", script)
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = module
spec.loader.exec_module(module)

accepted = 0
timer_off = 0
unsafe_accepted = 0
for line in Path("/tmp/stage28e_h_v7_corrected_parser_v1.log").read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
    if not module.is_stage28d_output_line(line):
        continue
    values = dict(module.KV_RE.findall(line))
    state = module.output_state(values)
    if state is None:
        continue
    safety = int(state["safety"])
    force = int(state["force"])
    reason = int(state["reason"])
    if module.is_h_safety_clear(safety, force, reason):
        accepted += 1
        if reason == module.LAMP_SAFETY_REASON_TIMER_OFF:
            timer_off += 1
    if reason in (2, 3, 4, 5) and module.is_h_safety_clear(safety, force, reason):
        unsafe_accepted += 1
assert accepted > 0, accepted
assert timer_off > 0, timer_off
assert unsafe_accepted == 0, unsafe_accepted
print(f"STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_V7_REPLAY_PASS accepted={accepted} timer_off={timer_off}")
PY
else
  echo STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_V7_REPLAY_SKIPPED log_missing=1
fi
git diff --check
changed=$(git diff --name-only)
test "$changed" = "$(printf '%s\n' scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py tests/test_stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py)"
if git diff --name-only | grep -Eq '\.(c|cc|cpp|h|hpp)$'; then
  echo "unexpected production C/C++ change" >&2
  exit 91
fi
echo STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_DIFF_PASS

set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_HEAD=782d53a7f6203bf31b3435a4ad91711efc21a1b3
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
git add scripts/stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py tests/test_stage28e_phase_h_closed_tent.py
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m "Accept TimerOff in Phase H safety-clear observer"
git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
NEW_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test "$NEW_HEAD" != "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo STAGE28E_H_TIMEROFF_FIX_COMMIT_PASS head=$NEW_HEAD
